title: Card Magic for Beginners
subtitle: A crash course in the basics of sleight-of-hand card magic.
description:
You’ll learn to handle a deck of cards like a pro. Skills taught include how to shuffle cards, control cards, and more. Plus learn tricks you can perform right away to entertain your friends, family, and maybe even fool a magician.

Registration includes a deck of cards for each attendee.

$49, or $39 if you register by January 3.

About the instructor:
Dan Feltey is a Chicago-based magician, improviser, and producer. He is a graduate of Annoyance training center and the Second City Conservatory programs. He regularly performs magic at comedy venues around Chicago including the stages of Second City, iO, the Annoyance, Lincoln Lodge, Laugh Factory, Bughouse, Playground, and Stars & Garters. You can catch him performing magic weekly on Friday nights and Saturday mornings at Stars & Garters in Wrigleyville.
